_note: The base kits (docs/plans/rebuild-phase2-heroes-enemies.md, section 3; docs/plans/rebuild-heroes.md, sections 4 and 6-8). Heroes act in this order in a fight. Stats and mana are the design's; cooldowns, Mend's heal, and Hearthguard's Shield are first numbers for step 7 to tune.
name: Brannoc of the Hearthwatch
title: the warden

basic_attack.name: Shield Bash
basic_attack.text: Bashes the enemy in front of him.

signature._note: Taunts enemies within 2 hexes for Taunt's own 3s. The DEF is the passive of the same name below: it holds while any enemy is taunted by him.
signature.name: Hold the Line
signature.text: Taunts every enemy within 2 hexes of him, so they turn on him instead.

passives.name: Hold the Line
passives.text: His DEF is 1.5 times as high while any enemy is taunted by him.

passives.name: Hearthguard
passives.text: The first ally to fall low on HP gets a Shield from him, once a fight.

kit._note: Keep Your Distance is the hop_away trait: when an enemy comes within a hex, she hops a hex away, once every 6s.

basic_attack.name: Longshot
basic_attack.text: Shoots her target from up to 4 hexes away.

signature._note: Marked for its own 4s: +15% damage taken from everyone.
signature.name: Marking Shot
signature.text: Marks the nearest enemy within 4 hexes, so it takes more damage from everyone for a while.

passives.name: Slip Away
passives.text: Each time she hops away, she slips from sight for a moment: no enemy can target her.

basic_attack._note: Slow, but her main source of mana: about 10 mana a second while she attacks.
basic_attack.name: Lantern Glow
basic_attack.text: Throws lantern light at her target from up to 3 hexes away. Weak, but it's where most of her mana comes from.

signature._note: The ally lowest on HP% within 3 hexes, Vell included.
signature.name: Mend
signature.text: Heals whichever ally within 3 hexes is lowest on HP, herself included.

passives.name: Hearthlight
passives.text: Every second, heals the other allies within 1 hex of her by a little of their max HP.

_note: Hero 4 (docs/plans/rebuild-heroes.md section 8d; rebuild-phase8-heroes.md 8d-1). Haul's mana is the design's; Chain Fist's cooldown and the mana gains are first numbers. HP, ATK, and DEF (550, 26, 40, from the design's 380, 18, 22) bring his base team within 10 points of the old three's in Act 1 (build-tuning.md, section 4).
name: Garrow of the Chains
title: the anchor

basic_attack.name: Chain Fist
basic_attack.text: A heavy blow on the enemy in front of him.

signature.name: Haul
signature.text: Throws a chain at the farthest enemy within 4 hexes and drags it next to him.

passives.name: Stand Fast
passives.text: The first time he drops below half his HP in a fight, he gains a Shield.

passives.name: Heavy
passives.text: Nothing can knock him back or pull him.

_note: Hero 5 (docs/plans/rebuild-heroes.md section 8c; rebuild-phase8-heroes.md 8d-3). HP, DEF, CRIT, speed, and Shadowstep's mana are the design's; ATK 16 (the design's 24) and a 1s Knife with +10 attack speed bring her base team within 10 points of the old three's in Act 1 (30% against 22%; at 24 it won 53%: build-tuning.md, section 4). The mana gains and Shadowstep's 3-hex reach are first numbers. Hidden is her own Stealth: it ends as her next basic attack fires, and that attack is from Stealth.
name: Tamsin Gloamstep
title: the knife

basic_attack.name: Knife
basic_attack.text: A quick stab at the enemy in front of her. She goes for the weakest enemy within 3 hexes, else the nearest.

signature.name: Shadowstep
signature.text: She slips behind the weakest enemy within 3 hexes and is hidden until she next strikes.

passives.name: From the Dark
passives.text: Her attacks from Stealth always crit.

_note: Hero 6 (docs/plans/rebuild-heroes.md section 8e; rebuild-phase8-heroes.md 8d-4). Stats, mana, Peal, and Resonance are the design's; Toll's 1.2s cooldown is a first number. He can't be drafted until his paths come.
name: Aldous Vesper
title: the bell-ringer

basic_attack.name: Toll
basic_attack.text: A ringing note at the nearest enemy within 3 hexes. Where most of his mana comes from.

signature.name: Peal
signature.text: The bell peals: the allies within 3 hexes of him attack faster for a while.

passives.name: Resonance
passives.text: The allies within 2 hexes of him attack a little faster.

_note: Hero 7 (docs/plans/rebuild-heroes.md section 8g; rebuild-phase8-severine-edric.md 8e-1). Stats, mana, Rend, Drain, and Hemophage are the design's; Rend's 1.1s cooldown is a first number. She never heals: all her sustain is lifesteal. She can't be drafted until her paths come.
name: Severine Hollowell
title: the bloodwitch

basic_attack.name: Rend
basic_attack.text: A clawing strike at the enemy beside her that heals her by part of the damage. Where most of her mana comes from.

signature.name: Drain
signature.text: She tears into an enemy within 1 hex and drinks: a heavy strike that heals her by half the damage.

passives.name: Hemophage
passives.text: Her lifesteal is doubled against enemies below half their HP.

_note: Hero 8 (docs/plans/rebuild-heroes.md section 8h; rebuild-phase8-severine-edric.md 8e-1). Stats, mana, Ward, and Vigil are the design's; Seal's 1.2s cooldown is a first number. He can't be drafted until his paths come.
name: Edric Tithewell
title: the tithe-warden

basic_attack.name: Seal
basic_attack.text: A stamped seal at the nearest enemy within 3 hexes. Where most of his mana comes from.

signature.name: Ward
signature.text: He wards the whole team: every ally gains a Shield.

passives.name: Vigil
passives.text: Shielded allies within 2 hexes of him take less damage.

_note: Hero 9 (docs/plans/rebuild-heroes.md section 8b; rebuild-phase8-last-heroes.md 8f-1). Stats and Flare are the design's; Heat is her only mana, 3 a tick (the design's 1, so she casts at all), and Cinder Flick's 1.2s cooldown keeps her team within the base-kit band (+9).
name: Ilse Cinderhand
title: the fire-speaker

basic_attack.name: Cinder Flick
basic_attack.text: A mote of fire at the nearest enemy within 3 hexes that sets it Burning. It gives her no mana.

signature.name: Flare
signature.text: A fireball bursts around an enemy within 3 hexes: every enemy within 1 hex of it is set Burning.

passives.name: Heat
passives.text: Her only mana: each time Burn ticks on an enemy within 3 hexes of her, whoever set it, she gains a little.

_note: Hero 10 (docs/plans/rebuild-heroes.md section 8i; rebuild-phase8-last-heroes.md 8f-2). Volatile Flask and Brewing are the design's; MGK 16, not 18, keeps her team within the base-kit band (+9; 18 was +12, and a slower Toss barely moved it).
name: Ottilie Brack
title: the alchemist

basic_attack.name: Toss
basic_attack.text: A vial thrown at the nearest enemy within 3 hexes. Her main source of mana.

signature.name: Volatile Flask
signature.text: A flask bursts around an enemy within 3 hexes: every enemy within 1 hex of it is hit, set Burning, and Poisoned.

passives.name: Brewing
passives.text: Every 4s her next Toss carries a vial, fire and venom in turn: it sets the enemy it hits Burning or Poisoned. With nothing within 3 hexes, no vial flies.

_note: Hero 11 (docs/plans/rebuild-heroes.md section 8k; rebuild-phase8-last-heroes.md 8f-3). DEF, CRIT, speed, range, mana, Sic 'Em, Bond, and Grit's shares are the design's; HP 250 and ATK 15 (the design's 300 and 18) keep her team within the base-kit band (+10); Spear Jab's 1.2s cooldown and Grit's DEF, speed, and 0.8s bite are first numbers. She can't be drafted until her paths come.
name: Kestra Fenn
title: the beastwarden

basic_attack.name: Spear Jab
basic_attack.text: A thrust at the nearest enemy within 2 hexes. Her main source of mana.

signature.name: Sic 'Em
signature.text: Grit leaps on her target within 2 hexes and bites it hard.

passives.name: Bond
passives.text: While Grit stands, she attacks faster.

basic_attack.name: Bite
basic_attack.text: A fast bite at the enemy in front of him.
